snippet.title: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation | Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation
強制共鳴工房：デジャ・ダムネーション

Welcome to your mandatory afterlife orientation.

REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation is a psychological horror visual novel about corporate training after death.

Complete the modules.
Review your files.
Follow System instructions.

Demo available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4504980

Wishlist the full game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4424600

Steam Next Fest begins June 15.

Attendance is mandatory. Sanity is optional.

Developer: Moiré X Studio

#psychologicalhorror #visualnovel #horrorgame #animehorror #SteamNextFest #indiegame #ゲーム
